messages.author: 519455d3bf64680d
messages.subject: Capturing output of a stat_ function?
parts:
Is there any way to see the data frame that is being passed to
ggplot/qplot when one uses the y=..density.. function? (or any other
stat_ function for that matter). I know what the original data looks
like (obviously), but I need to see the x/y pairs being passed into
ggplot from stat="density".

Thanks,

Rob
